versions.changelog: Sanitize: remove hardcoded personal paths and names

Initial release of cloakbrowser-stealth, providing automated stealth browsing for bypassing bot detection.

- Enables fetching content from sites protected against standard automation (Playwright/Puppeteer) using CloakBrowser.
- Supports extraction of specific DOM elements, full-page text, and screenshots.
- Includes human-like browsing mode to further evade bot detection.
- Provides structured JSON outputs for downstream processing.
- Clear exit codes and error handling for various anti-bot and navigation failures.
- Suitable for scraping public reviews, listings, and non-login content blocked by anti-bot measures.
